author: shabana khan
content: We hired the small square ball pool and the indigo package for our 2 year old's birthday party at Toms Kitchen Canary wharf  and it was the right size and really good for the venue, though we did have to leave a few mats as  there were lots of adults too and we needed more space, these 2 fit perfectly and the children had so much fun! almost 10-12 children were playing in these 2 at a time. The condition of the soft play was great and the staff are very polite, would definitely recomend this company.
